claims.observation: The same initial dungeon state uses a constrained near-black, charcoal, deep olive, moss, green-brown, and muted stone family instead of the blue-gray/purple prototype palette.
claims.verification: Independent 1280x720 browser captures were taken after fresh navigation with no input; geometry and UI state match while the palette changes from blue-purple to olive/stone.

claims.observation: Depth changes wall color: near walls are more visible, middle walls are darker, far walls are subdued, and the visibility terminus is effectively black.
claims.verification: The render selects nearWall/middleWall/farWall by visible-cell distance and fills an unblocked distance-3 terminus with visibilityTerminus.

claims.observation: Gameplay-important UI uses controlled accents: hostile and warning text/borders are rust, player status is moss, and narrative text is muted ochre.
claims.verification: ArrowUp entered the deterministic encounter from the same initial state; combat UI remained readable and separate from the dungeon frame.

claims.observation: The palette change does not alter authoritative simulation behavior.
claims.verification: The simulation source was unchanged and all 7 simulation tests passed.

verification.runtime: Playwright fresh navigation at 1280x720; initial and encounter states captured; browser console errors: 0, warnings: 0
